title: BusinessProcessGroup - Data API
description: Setup object that stores information about customer lifecycle maps. Customer lifecycle maps are used to track the scores provided by customers across their lifecycle using Salesforce Surveys. This object is reserved for internal use, and is available in API version 49.0 and later.

CustomerSatisfactionMetric.description: Represents the question type that measures the customers' Net Promote Score or satisfaction score across their lifecycle. Possible values are: NPS Rating

Description.description: Description of the customer lifecycle map.

DeveloperName.description: Developer name the customer lifecycle map. Note: Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

Language.description: The language of the MasterLabel. Possible values are: da—Danish de—German en_US—English es—Spanish es_MX—Spanish (Mexico) fi—Finnish fr—French it—Italian ja—Japanese ko—Korean nl_NL—Dutch no—Norwegian pt_BR—Portuguese (Brazil) ru—Russian sv—Swedish th—Thai zh_CN—Chinese (Simplified) zh_TW—Chinese (Traditional)

MasterLabel.description: Label of the customer lifecycle map.
